caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a Western-style saddle. The saddle is predominantly brown with intricate floral patterns carved across the main body, including the fenders and skirt. The seat, fork, and cantle are upholstered in a lighter beige or off-white material, which is decorated with gold or tan swirling embroidery designs. The saddle is equipped with a stirrup on the visible side, which is light gray or white and hangs from a brown leather strap. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the saddle as the central object. The artist’s signature, “D. F. Miller,” is visible below the saddle on the right side.
title: Side Saddle
